items.title: Catalog of Misplaced Things
items.summary: Asked to list 10 things I’ve lost, I faltered. A blue feather, favorite glove, newly cut keys. Love and flexibility. You asked me once if you had death inside you and I lied. After the wake, I waded through tall grasses—skin electric. I felt guilty for happiness, that I was able to undertake simple pleasures like putting my face in the lilacs or breathing in earth, after rain. I listened to your last voice message and when I looked on the screen there were violets. I couldn’t list 10 things. Inside me, a sonata. Outside, a day moon.
